categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and modifies Guix build manifests and scripts in contrib/guix/.
categories.rationale: Updates the Guix time-machine and toolchain dependencies to unblock native building on RISC-V systems (fixing #36232). While review objections note several host-specific build failures needing resolution, keeping the deterministic release environment current and resolving platform build issues carries substantial strategic value for build infrastructure.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Changes are confined to Guix release build scripts and manifests, which the category explicitly excludes as build system domain.
categories.rationale: Guix manifests and helper scripts are build and release tooling; the tools category explicitly states that build and release scripts belong to the build category.
